body:
## What to build

Allow an omitted local classed scalar dimension to expand with a typed-missing Margin label whenever ordinary dplyr/vctrs mutation and branch combination support that column. Constructing the omitted value must not turn a supported class into an incompatible bare vector.

On main 339315c387f31deace77566f5d3294b15b323865, a one-row tibble contains a stats::dist value holding the distance between 0 and 1 and a source-row identifier. Included-only expansion succeeds. A rollup with a NULL Margin label instead raises vctrs_error_ptype2: “Can't combine `..1$key` <dist> and `..2$key` <double>.” Ordinary row-sized vec_init mutation followed by union_all succeeds, retaining the original distance and one typed-missing distance with the required payload multiplicity. An independent three-distance fixture reproduces the same contrast. logLik dimensions reach the same failure.

The one-dimensional table repair in closed #1071 covered array-shaped columns. These scalar classed vectors have no array dimensions and still use NA subsetting that drops their class. This is separate from class-specific missingness validation and from arbitrary attribute restoration: ADR 0016 leaves the resulting class and attributes to the ordinary dplyr/vctrs composition.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] NULL and NA_character_ Margin labels expand dist and logLik dimensions with the same scalar values, resulting type, and source-row multiplicity as successful ordinary typed-missing mutation/combination controls.
- [ ] Cover empty and populated inputs, included-first and omitted-first plans, retained duplicate occurrences, and optional public Grouping set identifiers.
- [ ] Included-only, fixed-key, payload, packed-column, factor, atomic, and array controls retain their established ordinary behavior.
- [ ] Local data.frame, tibble, and data.table cases use their ordinary type rules; any independently unsupported sorting or class operation remains distinguished from the unsorted expansion contract.
- [ ] The repair adds no general attribute-restoration policy and no unrequested read of a lazy input.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Investigation evidence

The October 31 investigation retained a minimal expected-behavior replay, a separate independent witness, cause-isolating prototype controls, and a 1,944-comparison matrix. All ordinary controls succeeded; 432 direct-dimension cases failed only in expansion. No implementation fix was included.

[The dated investigation](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/b38efbbbfde867800112bf117fe94f15d9745685/investigation/expand-grouping-greedy-hunt-2026-10-31.md) records finding L1, its controls, and limits. [The expected-behavior replay](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/b38efbbbfde867800112bf117fe94f15d9745685/investigation/2026-10-31-expand-grouping-greedy/local/reproduce-dist-prototype.R) and adjacent logs/CSVs are pinned to the published evidence commit. Its `--assert` mode intentionally fails on the investigated baseline.

title: [P2] Preserve supported scalar class types in omitted Margin dimensions
